alias_decisions.a3_action: Author a distinct bog_iron feedstock or source-tagged smelting path when the Ashwater pump loop is implemented; retain A1 node renewal.
alias_decisions.reason: Slow redox renewal at peat margins is not A3 finite-vein iron_ore. Keep bog_iron provenance for pump/filter-frame and late-tool sinks; do not collapse renewal/rarity into generic ore.

alias_decisions.a3_action: Author glacial_iron or a cold-crucible bloom path for thermal ward/deep pressure frames; keep thaw-season vein provenance.
alias_decisions.reason: Thaw-season magnetite skarn is a high-grade thermal/pressure feedstock, not generic iron_ore. Collapsing it removes the Frostcrown preparation identity.

alias_decisions.a3_action: Map only riverine/lake reed sites (e.g. src_crown_reed, src_mere_reed) to reed_fibre; keep oasis/forest fibre as dry_fibre or a distinct A3 item before Saffron filter/rope sinks.
alias_decisions.reason: A1 fibre spans river-margin reed and oasis/forest understorey. A3 reed_fibre is wetland-specific. First-hour filter mesh needs an explicit source-side split, not a global rename.

alias_decisions.a3_action: Reject hardwood=oak_wood. A0/A3 should author a hardwood construction tag/item for hulls and boardwalks; keep oak_wood for early generic timber.
alias_decisions.reason: Monsoon emergent hardwood is a slow-grove boat hull/boardwalk/advanced-frame material. oak_wood is generic structural timber; aliasing would erase boat logistics and rarity.

alias_decisions.a3_action: Add frost_resin item and frost_extract/thermal-ward sink; retain tapped-stand cooldown. Do not rename frost_shard.
alias_decisions.reason: Tapped conifer cold-stress exudate is ecological, not mineral frost_shard. Approve the smallest A3 split because thermal ward/cold-seal core is a real sink.

alias_decisions.a3_action: Add peat fuel/charcoal path and filter-carbon sink; preserve very slow cut renewal and Ashwater provenance.
alias_decisions.reason: Cut acid-bog peat is a very slow renewable fuel/filter carbon, not geological coal. Approve split only with a real peat_charcoal/furnace-fuel or filter-carbon sink.

alias_decisions.a3_action: Map orchard/remnant plot morphs (e.g. src_amber_herb) to moonleaf only with a real potion/filter/grafting sink; keep karst/cenote rare_herb distinct.
alias_decisions.reason: A1 rare_herb is broader than A3 moonleaf. First-hour filter preparation needs an explicit orchard-understorey mapping; cenote/karst herbs must not collapse into moonleaf.

alias_decisions.a3_action: Add venom_sac fauna-source item and extract_venom/toxin_mask sink; keep fauna respawn provenance. venom_spine remains a separate reward.
alias_decisions.reason: Fauna venom sac is not A3 venom_spine reward. Approve split because extract_venom/toxin_mask/venom-core are real sinks; bootstrap filter must not require venom_sac before cap_filter exists.

missing_items.dependency: Power circuits, seal-2 forge, storm signal, pumps; first-hour relay uses a salvage/timber hand-crank bypass, so copper is not a first-hour softlock.
Boat hull seals, deepward/tide-ward insulation; mid-game traversal preparation.
Mortar, filter bed, grafting bed; A0 construction/A1 preparation gap.
Food/fermentation/trade; not required for the first-hour filter lesson.
Food preservation, flux, trade; Saffron logistics.
Seal inlay, trade, lens; access seals are credentials, not pearl crafts by default.
Glass furnace/lens path; prerequisite for storm_glass identity.
Signal tower/storm core; late Glasswind objective.
Heat-proof construction; primarily A0 construction material.
Tier-3 seal/abyssal core; late Pearl objective.
Core blanks/power nodes; not interchangeable with ancient_catalyst without a design decision.

principles: material_key remains A1 world-source truth; A3 owns item ids, recipes, yields, prices and migration.
No alias is provenance-equivalent unless explicitly approved; source/renewal/sink/rarity must survive adoption.
MISSING_A3_ITEM remains explicit; do not manufacture filler items to reduce the count.
First-hour bootstrap may not depend on a downstream-gated sustain material.
